note: Editorial topics register for the marketing set. Each row is an angle the site could publish, written so that a reader (and the owner) can see what it would argue, which verified rows would support it, and whether it is published, queued, or blocked on data that no official source provides. Nothing here is a product claim: a topic that would need a rating, a price or a measured result is marked `needs-data` and cannot be written from this repository's evidence.

status_meaning.published: live on the site, built from verified rows
status_meaning.queued: writable today from rows that already exist
status_meaning.needs-data: blocked: the angle needs a figure this repository cannot verify (price, rating, measured time or energy, demand data)
status_meaning.blocked: blocked on a decision the owner has to make first

topics.headline: Dual basket or single basket? The difference actually matters
topics.angle: Two independent baskets cook two foods at once and stop one finishing before the other; a single basket is one cavity. It is the clearest structural difference between the models here, and the one a household can feel on a Tuesday evening.
